input:
The distance of the point having position vector i - 2j - 6k from the straight line passing through the point (2,-3,-4) and parallel to the vector 6i + 3j - 4k is

Options:
A. sqrt(340/61)
B. 341/61
C. sqrt(341)/61
D. sqrt(341/61)

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Compute shortest distance between a point and a line in 3D.
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Use distance formula based on cross product magnitude.

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Form vectors P-A and b, compute cross product norm and divide by |b|.

phase_5_verify_answer.verification: Cross-product distance formula gives exactly sqrt(341/61).
